title: She Spoke Smooth Musical Sentences, Yet Could Not Understand One Spoken Word
description:
You think smooth musical speech proves your brain understands words! Yet strokes can spare fast talk while erasing word meaning! This is the true story of the German fluent stroke discovery. Here is what went wrong inside early hospital wards.
